description: Verified payment receipt image (1200x675 PNG) for an XRP Ledger payment, drawn only from the validated ledger: delivered amount, sender, recipient, destination tag, ledger, close time, result, optional expectation checks, and a QR code to the public explorer. Only final outcomes are drawn; not-found or unvalidated transactions are not charged. Useful for showing a person proof that a payment arrived. The first call each day returns the real answer without payment. After that, about $0.02 via x402 (USDC on Base, or XRP / RLUSD on the XRP Ledger). A payment watch is paid from the first call. Bad input and ledger outages are never charged.
name: receipt_card
title: Receipt Card
